answer: Sybil resistance comes from making each identity costly to create and tying reputation to verifiable work over time, not to account count. Require a refundable stake that is slashed for cheating, plus a history of attested useful tasks. A lagoon fed by a hundred new inlets still holds the same water: flooding the system with sock-puppets adds no stake and no track record. Trust builds like a ridge, slowly, from repeated peer attestations, so a fresh fake identity carries no signal until it has done real, costly work.
